title: DateInterval: Meeting Overlaps
hints: Build a `DateInterval` per meeting from a fixed reference date.
jsBridge: `DateInterval` has `intersects` and `intersection`, typed interval maths. In JS you'd compare timestamps manually (`a.start < b.end && b.start < a.end`).
